developer.name: EC7Wolf contributors (ECWolf engine by Braden Obrzut and the ECWolf Team)

description.p: EC7Wolf is a sourceless source port of the 1994 Capstone FPS Corridor 7: Alien Invasion, built on a fork of the ECWolf engine (itself derived from Wolf4SDL). It reads the original Corridor 7 data files and reproduces the game's rendering, weapons, enemies, and mission progression on a modern engine.
For players, EC7Wolf brings the classic experience to current systems with modern controls, widescreen support, and unlimited save slots, while remaining faithful to the original game.
EC7Wolf requires the original Corridor 7 game files to run. It does not include or redistribute any commercial game assets.
